integrations.name: Control-plane UI
integrations.notes: Vite + React + TanStack Router/Query board, task detail, settings and fixture-mode pages served from apps/web.

integrations.name: PostgreSQL + Drizzle
integrations.notes: Hono API with Drizzle ORM; migrations in apps/api/drizzle, seed via pnpm --filter @sdlc-ai/api db:seed.

integrations.name: GitHub (Octokit)
integrations.notes: Issues, branches, PRs, merges and manifest reads through the GitHub service.

integrations.name: Docker sandbox + OpenCode Zen
integrations.notes: Task containers built by sandbox/build.mjs; agents run inside via OpenCode. Deploy polling via CLOUDFLARE/RENDER providers.
